# Core Always-On Routes

Always-on routes represent operations that an authenticated end user executes during their own conversational sessions. They are enabled unconditionally (no capability flags required) and are strictly scoped to the `userId` resolved by your [`resolveUser`](/packages/runtime/v0.10.0/guides/resolve-user) handler.

Every route except `GET /health` requires authentication; if `resolveUser` returns `null` or throws, the runtime responds with `401 Unauthorized`.

---

## Route Summary

| Method | Path | Description | Upstream SDK Equivalent |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `POST` | `/chat` | Streams an AG-UI run over SSE | `client.chat.stream()` |
| `GET` | `/chat/:runId/resume` | Reconnects to an in-progress or finished run | Internal `RunDriver` replay |
| `GET` | `/threads` | Lists threads for the resolved user | `client.threads.list()` |
| `POST` | `/threads` | Creates a new conversation thread | `client.threads.create()` |
| `GET` | `/threads/:id` | Retrieves thread metadata | `client.threads.get()` |
| `PATCH` | `/threads/:id` | Updates title or archive status | `client.threads.update()` |
| `DELETE` | `/threads/:id` | Deletes a thread | `client.threads.delete()` |
| `POST` | `/threads/bulk-delete`| Deletes multiple threads | `client.threads.bulkDelete()` |
| `GET` | `/threads/:id/messages`| Returns full message history & state | `client.threads.getMessages()` |
| `POST` | `/threads/:id/reset` | Clears messages/state in place | `client.threads.reset()` |
| `POST` | `/voice/sessions` | Mints a Gemini Live audio ticket | `client.voice.createSession()` |
| `GET` | `/agents` | Read-only discovery list of agents | `client.agents.list()` |
| `GET` | `/files` | Lists files uploaded by user | `client.files.list()` |
| `POST` | `/files` | Multipart upload for chat attachments | `client.files.upload()` |
| `GET` | `/files/:id` | Streams raw file binary bytes | `client.files.download()` |
| `DELETE` | `/files/:id` | Deletes an uploaded file | `client.files.delete()` |
| `POST` | `/files/bulk-delete` | Deletes multiple files | `client.files.bulkDelete()` |
| `GET` | `/memory` | Lists memory files | `client.memory.list()` |
| `GET` | `/memory/file` | Reads a memory markdown file | `client.memory.getFile()` |
| `PUT` | `/memory/file` | Creates or writes a memory file | `client.memory.writeFile()` |
| `DELETE` | `/memory/file` | Deletes a memory file | `client.memory.deleteFile()` |
| `GET` | `/mcps/:id/oauth/*` | End-user OAuth connection flows | `client.mcps.oauth.*` |
| `GET` | `/workflows` | Lists available workflows | `client.workflows.list()` |
| `POST` | `/workflows/:id/stream` | Streams multi-step workflow execution with node events | `client.workflows.stream()` |
| `GET` | `/workflows/runs/:runId/resume` | Reconnects to in-flight or finished workflow run | Internal `RunDriver` replay |
| `POST` | `/workflows/runs/:runId/cancel` | Aborts an active workflow run | `client.workflows.cancel()` |
| `GET` | `/health` | Unauthenticated liveness & capabilities | `client.whoami()` |

## 1. Chat & Streaming

### `POST /chat`
Executes a turn of conversation with an Agent, streaming AG-UI protocol events over Server-Sent Events (SSE).

- **Headers Returned:**
  - `Content-Type: text/event-stream`
  - `x-persona-run-id`: Unique run identifier used for reconnection.
- **Request Body:**
  ```json
  {
    "agentId": "68f12a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d",
    "threadId": "thr_01928374",
    "messages": [
      { "role": "user", "content": "How do I renew my license?" }
    ],
    "resume": null,
    "contextOverride": {}
  }
  ```
- **SSE Events:** Streams `RUN_STARTED`, `TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK`, `TOOL_CALL_START`, `TOOL_CALL_RESULT`, `RUN_FINISHED`, or `RUN_ERROR`.

---

### `GET /chat/:runId/resume`
Reattaches a dropped connection to an ongoing or recently finished run.

- **Query Parameters:**
  - `since` *(optional, number)*: The last sequence number received by the client. The runtime replays all events with `seq > since` before continuing live stream output.
- **Example:**
  ```bash
  curl -N "http://localhost:3210/api/persona/chat/run_8f3d1c9e2a4b/resume?since=14"
  ```
- For deep architectural details, see [Streaming, Heartbeats & Resumability](/packages/runtime/v0.10.0/guides/streaming-and-resume).

---

## 2. Conversation Threads

### `GET /threads`
Lists conversation threads belonging to the authenticated user.

- **Query Parameters:** `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 20), `agentId` (optional filter).
- **Response:**
  ```json
  {
    "items": [
      {
        "_id": "thr_abc123",
        "agentId": "68f12a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d",
        "title": "License Renewal Questions",
        "createdAt": "2026-09-08T10:00:00.000Z",
        "updatedAt": "2026-09-08T10:05:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "total": 1,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 20
  }
  ```

---

### `POST /threads`
Explicitly mints a new Thread for an agent before sending the first message.

- **Request Body:**
  ```json
  {
    "agentId": "68f12a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d",
    "title": "Tax Filing 2026"
  }
  ```

---

### `GET /threads/:id/messages`
Retrieves the complete message history and internal graph state for a thread. Ideal for hydrating chat components when a user reopens a past conversation.

- **Response:**
  ```json
  {
    "threadId": "thr_abc123",
    "messages": [
      { "role": "user", "content": "Hello", "createdAt": "..." },
      { "role": "assistant", "content": "Hi there! How can I help?", "createdAt": "..." }
    ],
    "state": {
      "todos": [],
      "files": []
    }
  }
  ```

---

### `POST /threads/:id/reset`
Clears message history, uploaded file attachments, and internal agent state in-place, keeping the same Thread ID and title.

- **Response:** `200 OK` with updated thread object.

---

## 3. Real-Time Voice Sessions

### `POST /voice/sessions`
Mints an ephemeral ticket for a Gemini Live real-time audio conversation.

- **Request Body:**
  ```json
  {
    "agentId": "68f12a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d",
    "threadId": "thr_abc123"
  }
  ```
- **Response (`201 Created`):**
  ```json
  {
    "ticket": "vct_live_89a0b1c2...",
    "wsUrl": "wss://api.persona.hasanraiyan.me/v1/voice/live?ticket=vct_live_89a0b1c2...",
    "expiresAt": "2026-09-10T14:35:00.000Z",
    "session": {
      "id": "vcs_123",
      "agentId": "68f12a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d",
      "threadId": "thr_abc123"
    }
  }
  ```
- **Architecture Note:** The runtime only mints the ticket. Your frontend establishes the WebSocket directly with the Persona audio gateway using `wsUrl`. Audio bytes never route through your host server.

---

## 4. User Files

### `POST /files`
Uploads a file attachment for multi-modal agent inspection or RAG.

- **Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`
- **Fields:**
  - `file`: The binary file content (single file).
  - `agentId` *(optional)*: Associate file with an agent.
  - `threadId` *(optional)*: Associate file with a thread.
- **Response (`201 Created`):**
  ```json
  {
    "_id": "fil_987654",
    "filename": "quarterly-report.pdf",
    "size": 1048576,
    "contentType": "application/pdf",
    "createdAt": "2026-09-10T14:40:00.000Z"
  }
  ```

---

### `GET /files/:id`
Streams the raw binary bytes of a previously uploaded file.

- **Response Kind:** `binary` (streamed chunk-by-chunk with correct `Content-Type` and `Content-Disposition`).

---

## 5. Long-Term Memory

Persona agents can read and write persistent markdown files in either user-level or agent-level storage.

### `GET /memory`
Lists memory files available to the resolved user.

- **Query Parameters:**
  - `scope`: `'user'` (shared across all agents) or `'agent'` (specific to user + agent pair).
  - `agentId`: Required if `scope=agent`.

---

### `GET /memory/file`
Reads the content of a memory file.

- **Query Parameters:**
  - `path`: Required string (e.g. `/profile.md` or `/preferences/editor.md`).
  - `scope`: `'user'` | `'agent'`.
  - `agentId`: Required if `scope=agent`.

---

### `PUT /memory/file`
Creates or updates a memory file.

- **Request Body:**
  ```json
  {
    "path": "/preferences/learning-style.md",
    "content": "Prefers concise, code-first explanations with TypeScript examples.",
    "scope": "user"
  }
  ```

---

## 6. End-User MCP OAuth

### `GET /mcps/:id/oauth/user/authorize`
Returns a authorization URL to connect an end user’s external account (e.g. GitHub, Slack, Notion) via MCP.

- **Query Parameters:** `returnTo` (redirect destination after authorization).
- **Response:** {}`

### `GET /mcps/:id/oauth/user/status`
Checks if the resolved user has an active connection to the specified MCP server.

- **Response:** {}`

### `DELETE /mcps/:id/oauth/user/connection`
Disconnects the end user's account from the MCP connector (`204 No Content`).

---

## 7. Health & Capabilities Probe

### `GET /health`
Liveness check that returns the current runtime version and active capability flags.

- **Authentication:** None (open route).
- **Response:**
  ```json
  {
    "status": "ok",
    "version": "0.10.0",
    "capabilities": {
      "agentsWrite": false,
      "mcps": false,
      "providers": false,
      "skills": false,
      "knowledge": false,
      "stores": false,
      "auditLogs": false,
      "architect": false
    }
  }
  ```
